catches: Only pursue this with spending you already planned; never buy extra to hit the $1,000 threshold.
Regions credit cards are only available to applicants in states where Regions operates branches (15 states) — check eligibility before the hard inquiry.
Applying involves a hard credit inquiry when Regions processes the application.
The card has no annual fee, but carrying a balance after the 0% intro APR period at the regular variable APR erases the bonus — pay in full.
Cash rewards expire 48 months after they are earned and redeem in $25 increments (up to $500 per single redemption).
Balance transfers, cash advances, fees, and gift-card/quasi-cash purchases do not count toward the $1,000 spend threshold.

steps: Confirm you live in a state where Regions Bank operates (AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KY, LA, MS, MO, NC, SC, TN, or TX) — the card is not available outside its footprint.
Open the official Regions page https://www.regions.com/personal-banking/credit-cards and apply for the Cash Rewards Visa Signature — do not apply from an affiliate link with different terms.
Complete the application; Regions runs a hard credit inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $1,000 on purchases you were already planning within the first 90 days of account opening.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at the regular variable APR after the intro period destroys the bonus.
The $200 bonus cash rewards post to your account; redeem for a statement credit, check, or deposit into your Regions account (redemptions in $25 increments).
